name: Indiana County, PA
findings: Indiana County has 390 nonprofit organizations. 170 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 139 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Indiana County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
